module: Declares the "topRight" app container (top-right corner of the interface) with ui_appContainers, with the UI trigger setTopRightAppVisibility. The app list is empty in 0.40.5: the container exists but manages no app.
notes: Replaces the old identifier secondaryApps (see ui_appContainers.resolveContainerId).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called when the extension loads: registers the topRight container (no apps) via ui_appContainers.registerContainer.
